mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST shows a sustained 3-month increase but 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals improving labor market conditions, which positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 1 month but does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic activity, which positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month but does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals strong consumer demand, which positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in 1 quarter but does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, which positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% in 1 month but does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a robust labor market, which positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month AND UNRATE decreases
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month AND UNRATE decreases but does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) coupled with an increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening economy, which boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases over 3 months AND HOUST increases
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases over 3 months AND HOUST increases but does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
